About us

We don’t score or rank projects.
We put the facts in plain view, so you can weigh what matters most to you.

Our story

Carbon offsets could do a great deal for the climate, but for most people they arrive wrapped in jargon, dense reports and data that’s hard to read. Good projects end up buried under documentation, and buying credits feels daunting rather than motivating.

Carbon projects are a bit like wine: everyone values something different.

One person loves bold tannins, another wants something fuller-bodied, someone else prefers a wine that’s plainly austere. Not sure what those terms mean? That’s the point. Carbon has its own vocabulary too, and we translate it so you can decide what actually matters to you.

We created Climate Simple to break down these barriers. You shouldn’t need a PhD, insider contacts or days of reading to understand a project and decide whether it’s right for you. We use AI to turn raw, unstructured project documents into clear, plain-language summaries and side-by-side comparisons, so anyone can explore and interpret carbon projects with confidence.

We stay neutral and transparent. We give you the knowledge, not a verdict: we never tell you what to buy and we never rate a project, so you can choose the climate action that means the most to you.

Our mission

To make carbon offsets easy to understand by turning complex project data into clear, unbiased information, so everyone can do their own due diligence and make climate choices with confidence.

Our vision

A world where understanding and acting on carbon offsets is simple, transparent and open to everyone, so millions of people can take part in climate action with clarity.
